You can find more of Creighton's work at Creightonirons.com. That's C-R-E-I-G-H-T-O-N-I-R-O-N-S.com. Next week, you'll hear from Danae Ringelman, Morehead King Class of 2000, and the co-founder of the industry-disrupting crowdfunding platform, Indiegogo. If you like what you've been hearing on Catalyse, please tell your friends and then rate and review us on Apple Podcasts. That really helps other people find us. Thanks as always for listening.
